Package neqsim.process.operations.replay

Class ProcessReplay

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.replay.ProcessReplay
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ProcessReplay extends Object implements Serializable
Replays a time series of plant data through a ProcessSystem or ProcessModel.

For every row of a ReplayTimeSeries the replay

  1. optionally filters the row (steady-state detector or user filter) and records it as skipped;
  2. converts and validates the input values and writes them with ProcessAutomation.setVariableValueSafe(String, double, String);
  3. runs the model with runUntilConverged(maxIterations) and reads the RunStatus;
  4. on non-convergence calls the optional ProcessReplay.RetryHook and re-runs, up to setMaxRetries(int);
  5. reads the outputs with ProcessAutomation.getVariableValueSafe(String, String) and records predictions, measurements and residuals.

A bad row never aborts the replay: it is recorded with status ReplayStepRecord.Status.INPUT_INVALID, ReplayStepRecord.Status.NOT_CONVERGED or ReplayStepRecord.Status.FAILED and the next row is processed.

State between steps. With warm start (default) the same model instance is used for all rows, so recycle tear streams, adjusters and controllers start from the previous step's solution; this is fast and mirrors a continuously running plant. After a failed or non-converged step the model is restored to its state before the replay unless setRestoreAfterFailure(boolean) is false. With cold start every row runs on a fresh deep copy of the model as it was when run(ReplayTimeSeries) was called, so rows are independent and order does not matter. The model passed to the constructor is never modified in cold-start mode; in warm-start mode it holds the last step's state afterwards.

    • setAllowAutoCorrection

      public ProcessReplay setAllowAutoCorrection(boolean allow)
      Allows the automation facade to auto-correct mistyped addresses (default false). Auto-correction uses fuzzy matching, so it is off by default to avoid silently writing to a different variable.
      Parameters:
      allow - true to accept auto-corrected addresses
      Returns:
      this replay

    • setSteadyStateDetector

      public ProcessReplay setSteadyStateDetector(SteadyStateDetector detector)
      Uses a SteadyStateDetector as step filter. All columns of each row are fed to the detector (variables that are not registered are ignored); rows are skipped while the detector does not report steady state.
      Parameters:
      detector - configured detector, or null to disable
      Returns:
      this replay
